checks.name: The reproduced 3 m/s lateral-force jump becomes a continuous contact law, including both blend boundaries
Wheel rays, contact velocities and forces use a consistent world-space contact basis and the real moment arm
Contact forces, regeneration and combined-drive budget are measured on low-speed turns, light inputs, circles, taps and lane changes
8 m/s E/Q commands and release braking become faster in both G modes without increasing available force
Manual full rotation, X and G recovery use bounded actual nozzles; the new default and maneuver preset have explicit different costs
Finite gas, overhead clearance, low altitude and G key semantics remain physical; mid-roll snapshots continue exactly

contactContinuity.scope: Local force-law state, not by itself an explanation of a high-speed slide.

contactGeometry.scope: An isolated numerical contact call, not a suspension calibration or a rendered inspection.

evidence.defaultRationale: 180 deg/s and 360 deg/s2 retain a less severe partial-roll/G recovery than the 240/480 maneuver preset. Both are references, not hard clips on actual body rates. X has an independent declared 360/720 quick-roll reference; preflight still accounts for actual pressure, available torque, finite impulse and clearance. The fourth quick-roll practice preset is tested in x-flip-3.13.

gSemantics315.reason: Explicit pilot pitch is intentionally accepted in 3.15; Z/B translation retains its original isolated tilt and displacement gates.

limits: Numerical dynamics only. Real keyboard/camera road feel still requires the matched live capture.
Large CG body beta on a tight low-speed turn can be kinematic; per-wheel slip and contact use are reported separately.
The raw tire capacity is unchanged. TCS reduces driver torque under combined demand; disabling it retains slide risk.
X uses an independent quick-roll reference. Force bounds and actual drop remain physical; manual comfort settings no longer slow X.
Engineering assumptions remain mu=1.25, 700 kW mechanical drive and 20 kN per main nozzle.
